title: 16.23. Kusalattika, Ajjhattikadukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Kusalaṁ bāhiraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naakusalo nabāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā nava …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate nava.
Abyākataṁ upādā dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo naupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Kusalaṁ noupādā dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo nanoupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā pannarasa, adhipatiyā pannarasa …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate pannarasa.

Abyākataṁ upādinnaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo naupādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Abyākataṁ upādinnaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naakusalo naupādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Abyākataṁ upādinnaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo naupādinno ca naakusalo naupādinno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
